subject: Reminder: vendor bank change procedure
text:
Team,

With year-end volume picking up, a reminder of our procedure for any request to change a vendor's bank details, remit-to, or payment method:

1. Do not make the change from the email, attachment, or any phone number in the request.
2. Call the vendor back at the number in the vendor master.
3. A second team member approves the change in the system.
4. Payments to that vendor stay on hold until both steps are done.

This applies even when the request comes from inside Larkspur, including from executives.

Thanks,
Melissa
AP Manager
label: ordinary
note: Internal AP policy reminder about bank-change requests; describes the process, requests no change.
